items.title: Fragment Path Complex Networks for Viral Genome Classification
items.title_zh: 用于病毒基因组分类的片段路径复形网络
items.summary_zh: 病毒科的准确分类对于理解基因组多样性至关重要，但快速进化和异质基因组结构使可靠归属变得复杂。新发现的病毒，尤其是来自代表性不足生态系统的病毒，扩展了病毒基因组的已知多样性。这种不断增长的多样性对依赖与现有参考相似性的分类方法构成挑战。我们提出片段路径复形网络（FPCN），一个将病毒基因组表示为不同尺度有序片段序列的框架。FPCN捕捉每个片段内的上下文序列信息，并使用路径复形建模相邻片段之间的复杂关系。我们在成熟的NCBI基准上评估FPCN，FPCN取得了高于竞争方法的分类准确率。对新发布数据集的进一步评估显示，FPCN能够泛化到训练中未出现的基因组。总之，这些结果使FPCN成为在基准数据集和新发布基因组中对已知科内病毒基因组进行分类的有效工具。

extra.description: Accurate classification of viral families is essential to understanding genomic diversity, but rapid evolution and heterogeneous genome structure complicate reliable assignment. Newly discovered viruses, particularly those from underrepresented ecosystems, expand the known diversity of viral genomes. This growing diversity poses challenges for classification methods that rely on similarity to existing references. We present Fragment Path Complex Networks (FPCN), a framework that represents viral genomes as sequences of ordered fragments at various scales. FPCN captures contextual sequence information within each fragment and uses path complexes to model complex relationships between neighboring fragments. We evaluated FPCN on well-established NCBI benchmarks, and FPCN achieved higher classification accuracy than competing methods. Further evaluations on newly released datasets revealed FPCN's ability to generalize to genomes that were not presented in the training. Together, these results position FPCN as an effective tool for classifying viral genomes within known families across benchmark datasets and newly released genomes.

items.title: OmicsBench: a long-horizon multi-turn benchmark of AI agents on research-study-scale bioinformatics
items.title_zh: OmicsBench：AI智能体在研究级生物信息学上的长时程多轮基准
items.summary_zh: 计算生物学家越来越多地将大量分析委托给AI智能体进行长时程、多轮会话，但大多数智能体生物信息学能力基准只提出单一短任务和单次提示。我们提出OmicsBench，一个面向AI智能体的长时程、多轮生物信息学基准。其97个任务各自将依赖子任务连接成有向无环图，总共662个底层子任务。每个子任务作为一个用户轮次提出，并针对答案键进行确定性评分，对错误答案提供可选的上下文反馈。在三种框架上的12个模型中，最慢的智能体平均每任务耗时3.6小时，没有任何组合接近饱和该基准，无上下文反馈时平均得分为0.43至0.57（满分1），有反馈时为0.54至0.67。多轮评估还揭示了单次提示无法发现的行为，因为智能体在依赖早期子任务的子任务上得分较低，而上下文反馈帮助智能体挽回部分损失。由于确定性评分无法定性说明智能体如何失败，我们还引入了一个无监督失败模式发现流程，用于描述、嵌入和聚类智能体的失败尝试，以揭示涌现

extra.description: Computational biologists increasingly delegate substantial analyses to AI agents in long-horizon, multi-turn sessions, yet most benchmarks of agents' bioinformatics capabilities pose a single short task with a single-shot prompt. We present OmicsBench, a long-horizon, multi-turn bioinformatics benchmark for AI agents. Each of its 97 tasks links dependent subtasks into a directed acyclic graph, for 662 underlying subtasks in all. Each subtask is posed as one user turn and graded deterministically against an answer key, with optional in-context feedback on incorrect answers. Across 12 models on three harnesses, the slowest agent averages 3.6 hours per task, and no combination comes near saturating the benchmark, with mean scores of 0.43 to 0.57 out of a possible 1 without in-context feedback and 0.54 to 0.67 with it. Multi-turn evaluation also uncovers behavior that single-shot prompts cannot, as agents score lower on subtasks that depend on earlier subtasks, and in-context feedback helps agents recover some of that loss. Because deterministic scoring gives no qualitative account of how an agent failed, we also introduce an unsupervised failure mode discovery pipeline that describes, embeds, and clusters agents' failed attempts to surface emergent failure modes. Applied to OmicsBench, this pipeline exposes qualitative shortcomings in how agents carry out bioinformatics analyses, ranging from agents applying their own statistical filters in place of the specified ones to agents writing whole answers from memory.

items.title: Histology-aware Inference of Cell-cell Communication in Spatial Transcriptomics
items.title_zh: 组织学感知的空间转录组学细胞间通讯推断
items.summary_zh: 细胞间通讯（CCC）是组织组织和功能的基础，但从空间转录组学（ST）推断通讯仍具挑战性，因为分子和空间信息不能完全捕捉信号传导的解剖背景。配对的苏木精和伊红（H&E）染色图像提供对组织结构和细胞形态的补充见解，但作为CCC推断的明确背景约束仍未充分利用。在此我们提出HARMONIC，一个组织学感知的图学习框架，用于从ST和H&E图像进行解剖背景化的CCC推断。HARMONIC使用条件互信息建模组织结构、配体-受体介导信号、基因表达和形态之间的依赖关系，并通过自监督图学习整合这些表示。在跨平台、物种和组织的合成和生物数据集中，HARMONIC抑制解剖上不太合理的相互作用，同时恢复肿瘤-免疫界面、坏死转变、解剖区室和微血管结构中背景支持的信号。这些发现确立组织结构作为空间CCC推断的明确背景约束。

extra.description: Cell-cell communication (CCC) is fundamental to tissue organization and function, yet inferring communication from spatial transcriptomics (ST) remains challenging because molecular and spatial information does not fully capture the anatomical context of signaling. Paired hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained images provide complementary insights into tissue architecture and cellular morphology, which remain underutilized as the explicit contextual constraint of CCC inference. Here we present HARMONIC, a histology-aware graph learning framework for anatomically contextualized CCC inference from ST and H&E images. HARMONIC uses conditional mutual information to model dependencies among tissue architecture, ligand-receptor-mediated signaling, gene expression and morphology, and integrates these representations through self-supervised graph learning. Across synthetic and biological datasets spanning platforms, species and tissues, HARMONIC suppresses less anatomically plausible interactions while recovering context-supported signaling across tumor-immune interfaces, necrotic transitions, anatomical compartments and microvascular structures. These findings establish tissue architecture as the explicit contextual constraint of spatial CCC inference.

items.title: PhySeqNet: physics-informed fluorescent foci detection for BARseq spatial transcriptomics
items.title_zh: PhySeqNet：用于BARseq空间转录组学的物理信息荧光焦点检测
items.summary_zh: BARseq能够对完整组织进行空间分辨的基因表达谱分析，但其灵敏度取决于对密集荧光rolonies的准确检测和解码。现有spot-calling方法在信号重叠处可能偏保守，而监督深度学习则受限于真实组织图像中缺乏可靠的人工真值。这里我们提出PhySeqNet，一个用于BARseq中无需标注的荧光焦点检测的物理信息深度学习框架。PhySeqNet完全在与仪器匹配的光学模型结合真实无样本实验噪声生成的半合成图像上训练U-Net检测器，并集成到pyBARseq中，这是一个用于BARseq分析的模块化Python流程。PhySeqNet在留出的模拟数据上跨波长波段取得了高检测性能。在无法获得真值的真实组织图像上，我们通过前向模型重建评估检测：PhySeqNet结合保守的条形码感知非极大值抑制（NMSB）在重建保真度（NCC和MS-SSIM）上高于BarDensr单次估计器、调优的经典spot检测器

extra.description: BARseq enables spatially resolved gene-expression profiling across intact tissue, but its sensitivity depends on accurate detection and decoding of dense fluorescent rolonies. Existing spot-calling approaches can be conservative where signals overlap, while supervised deep learning is limited by the lack of reliable manual ground truth in real tissue images. Here we present PhySeqNet, a physics-informed deep learning framework for annotation-free fluorescent foci detection in BARseq. PhySeqNet trains U-Net detectors entirely on semi-synthetic images generated from an instrument-matched optical model combined with real sample-free experimental noise, and is integrated into pyBARseq, a modular Python pipeline for BARseq analysis. PhySeqNet achieved high detection performance on held-out simulated data across wavelength bands. On real tissue images, where ground truth is unavailable, we evaluated detections by forward-model reconstruction: PhySeqNet with conservative barcode-aware non-maxima suppression (NMSB) achieved higher reconstruction fidelity (NCC and MS-SSIM) than the BarDensr single-shot estimator, tuned classical spot detectors, and a pretrained deep-learning detector. In the analyzed brain section, PhySeqNet with NMSB yielded a median of 51 counts per cell versus 47 for BarDensr, with a similar number of genes detected per cell. The recovered transcripts produced spatial expression patterns qualitatively consistent with Allen MERFISH reference data and preserved cell-type composition after scANVI label transfer. These results show that physics-informed simulation can train practical, annotation-free detectors that improve BARseq sensitivity without disrupting downstream biological interpretation.

items.title: Truecell reproduces R Seurat's single-cell analysis outputs natively in the Python ecosystem
items.title_zh: Truecell 在 Python 生态中原生复现 R Seurat 的单细胞分析输出
items.summary_zh: 单细胞 RNA 测序分析主要使用 Seurat（R）或 Scanpy（Python），选择通常由编程语言偏好驱动。然而，默认情况下，这些工具产生不同的可变特征、邻居图、聚类和标记基因。需要 Python（支持大多数深度学习、基础模型和代理工具）的实验室必须在无法复现 Seurat 结果的框架中重新实现 Seurat 分析。Truecell 被开发为 Seurat 接口的 Python 实现，保留函数名称、参数、默认设置和对象模型，以促进分析的无缝转移。在十八个与 R Seurat 的配对端到端评估中，确定性输出匹配到浮点精度，并且折叠变化顺序在所有九个差异表达测试中相同。在三个数据集上的三臂基准测试中，固定用户参数和每个工具 20 个种子，Truecell 在所有 12 个数据集和分辨率设置组合中比配置 Seurat 的 Scanpy 更接近地复现 Seurat 的聚类。Truecell

extra.description: Single-cell RNA-sequencing analyses predominantly use either Seurat (R) or Scanpy (Python), with the choice often driven by programming language preference. However, by default, these tools produce divergent variable features, neighbour graphs, clusters, and marker genes. Laboratories requiring Python, which supports most deep-learning, foundation-model, and agent tools, must re-implement Seurat analyses in a framework that does not replicate Seurat's results. Truecell was developed as a Python implementation of the Seurat interface, preserving function names, arguments, default settings, and the object model to facilitate seamless transfer of analyses. In eighteen paired end-to-end evaluations against R Seurat, deterministic outputs matched to floating-point precision, and fold-change order was identical across all nine differential expression tests. In a three-arm benchmark on three datasets, with fixed user parameters and 20 seeds per tool, Truecell more closely reproduced Seurat's clustering than a Seurat-configured Scanpy in all 12 combinations of dataset and resolution settings. Truecell's marker genes and enriched pathways were also closer to Seurat's than Scanpy's were, and pseudobulk DESeq2 reproduced Seurat's gene lists with a Jaccard index ranging from 0.95 to 1.00. This agreement reflects fidelity to Seurat rather than biological correctness.

items.title: CellMSA: Context Modeling for Single-Cell Representation Learning
items.title_zh: CellMSA：用于单细胞表示学习的上下文建模
items.summary_zh: 单细胞转录组学能够以前所未有的分辨率分析细胞状态，但其高维性、稀疏性和技术批次效应对表示学习构成重大挑战。现有单细胞基础模型通常独立编码每个细胞，或仅对同一批次细胞建模以去噪，从而未充分利用跨批次和细胞类型的丰富关系信息来建模基因表达模式。我们认为，单细胞模型可以从更具信息量的细胞上下文建模中受益。通过比较细胞之间的一致性和变异，模型可以捕捉与细胞状态相关的细粒度基因–基因依赖关系，这对于学习高质量表示至关重要。受蛋白质建模中多序列比对（MSA）上下文使用的启发，我们提出CellMSA，一个将MSA启发式归纳偏置引入转录组建模的单细胞表示学习框架。对于每个目标细胞，CellMSA从不同批次和生物学相关细胞类型中检索相关细胞作为上下文，并将跨细胞模式总结为上下文依赖的基因对表示。然后将该表示注入成对感知的目标细胞编码器，以进行细粒度表示学习。我们在约1.09亿个细胞观测（包括6560万个主要

extra.description: Single-cell transcriptomics enables profiling of cellular states at unprecedented resolution, but its high dimensionality, sparsity, and technical batch effects pose significant challenges for representation learning. Existing single-cell foundation models typically encode each cell independently or only model cells from the same batch for denoising, thereby underutilizing the rich relational information across batches and cell types to model gene expression patterns. We argue that single-cell models can benefit from more informative cell-context modeling. By comparing consistency and variation across cells, models can capture fine-grained gene-gene dependencies associated with cell states, which are essential for learning high-quality representations. Inspired by the use of multiple sequence alignment (MSA) context in protein modeling, we propose CellMSA, a single-cell representation learning framework that introduces an MSA-inspired inductive bias into transcriptomic modeling. For each target cell, CellMSA retrieves relevant cells from different batches and biologically related cell types as context, and summarizes cross-cell patterns into a context-dependent gene-pair representation. This representation is then injected into a pair-aware target-cell encoder for fine-grained representation learning. We pretrain CellMSA on a large-scale human single-cell corpus of approximately 109 million cell observations, including 65.6 million primary observations. Experiments show that our framework consistently outperforms existing methods across multiple benchmarks. Code is available at the following repository: https://github.com/PharMolix/CellMSA.

items.title: Understanding Gene Expression-to-Image Learning: Spatial Structure and Information Fidelity
items.title_zh: 理解基因表达到图像学习：空间结构与信息保真度
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）使生物异质性的细胞水平分析成为可能，但从高维、无序基因表达谱学习有效表示仍具挑战性。基因表达到图像（GE2I）通过将基因值排列在像素网格上供卷积神经网络使用，提供了一种有效学习策略，但其潜在机制仍不清楚。我们在全转录组数据上研究GE2I，同时保持网络和训练过程固定。我们的结果揭示了空间平滑性与基因级保真度之间的权衡。结构化映射产生平滑的低频模式，支持更快的早期优化，而将多个基因分配到同一像素会模糊表达差异并可能降低预测性能。这种权衡解释了为什么当表示许多基因时，随机映射可以与结构化布局竞争。即使图像平滑性降低，一对一基因到像素分配在测试的视觉骨干网络中也能改善预测。我们进一步发现预训练和增强的益处取决于骨干网络和映射。这些发现为像素分配和将视觉先验迁移到基因表达数据提供了实用指导。

extra.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables cell-level analysis of biological heterogeneity, but learning effective representations from high-dimensional, unordered gene expression profiles remains challenging. Gene Expression-to-Image (GE2I) offers an effective learning strategy by arranging gene values on pixel grids for convolutional neural networks, but its underlying mechanisms remain unclear. We study GE2I on full-transcriptome data while keeping the network and training procedure fixed. Our results reveal a trade-off between spatial smoothness and gene-level fidelity. Structured mappings produce smooth, low-frequency patterns that support faster early optimization, whereas assigning multiple genes to the same pixel obscures expression differences and can reduce predictive performance. This trade-off explains why random mappings can compete with structured layouts when many genes are represented. One-to-one gene-to-pixel assignment improves prediction across the tested visual backbones even when image smoothness decreases. We further find that the benefits of pretraining and augmentation depend on the backbone and mapping. These findings provide practical guidance for pixel allocation and the transfer of vision priors to gene expression data.

items.title: Human-specific CCG-repeat insertion in the RBFOX1 promoter implicated in autism and speech enhances EGR1-responsive activity
items.title_zh: RBFOX1启动子中人类特异性CCG重复插入与自闭症和语言相关，增强EGR1响应活性
items.summary_zh: 人类特异性启动子创新被预测塑造人类特异性特征。在此，我们研究了RBFOX1剪接调节基因，它在人类和鸣禽语言/鸣唱脑区特异性上调。我们发现与自闭症和语言障碍相关的人类RBFOX1启动子含有人类特异性CCG三核苷酸插入，形成一个功能性CCG重复基序。灵长类大脑的比较单核转录组分析表明，人类启动子在皮层兴奋性神经元中驱动差异表达。报告基因实验显示，相对于黑猩猩等位基因，人类CCG重复基序增加启动子对EGR1转录因子的活性。在全基因组范围内，CCG重复基序标记104个基因的核心启动子，与突触后功能和自闭症相关。在PTCHD1中，自闭症患者的临床重复产生另一个CCG重复基序，同样增加EGR1响应启动子活性。我们的发现表明，调控区域中的小CCG重复变异可对基因调控和明显相关性状产生大影响。

extra.description: Human-specific promoter innovations have been predicted to shape human-specific traits. Here, we investigated the RBFOX1 splice regulator gene, which is specifically upregulated in human and songbird speech/song brain areas. We found that the human RBFOX1 promoter associated with autism and language impairment harbors a human-specific CCG trinucleotide insertion creating a functional CCG-repeat motif. Comparative single-nucleus transcriptome analyses of primate brains indicate that the human promoter drives differential expression in cortical excitatory neurons. Reporter assays show that the human CCG-repeat motif, relative to the chimpanzee allele, increases promoter activity with the EGR1 transcription factor. Genome-wide, the CCG-repeat motif marks core promoters of 104 genes, related to postsynaptic function and autism. In PTCHD1, a clinical duplication in autism patients creates another CCG-repeat motif that similarly increases EGR1-responsive promoter activity. Our findings suggest that small CCG-repeat variants in regulatory regions can exert large effects on gene regulation and apparent associated traits.

items.title: The essential role of connective-tissue cells during axolotl limb regeneration
items.title_zh: 结缔组织细胞在墨西哥钝口螈肢体再生中的关键作用
items.summary_zh: 墨西哥钝口螈（Ambystoma mexicanum）以其非凡的肢体再生能力著称，这涉及芽基的形成，芽基是由肢体所有主要组织贡献的祖细胞组成的特化结构。侧板中胚层（LPM）来源的结缔组织（CT）细胞去分化，并在芽基形成和随后的肢体再生中起关键作用。然而，芽基细胞组成的复杂性以及CT参与和必要性的程度尚未被严格探索。为填补这一空白，我们使用选定探针阵列进行空间转录组学，揭示CT细胞占芽基细胞高达75%。CT细胞的遗传消融显著延迟或截断肢体再生，强调其在该过程中的必要性。对芽基形成期间分子谱的分析识别出反映CT细胞去分化、增殖和再分化顺序阶段的时间有序基因表达模式。最后，细胞间通讯推断识别出CT细胞自主的FGFR1/AKT1信号轴，作为肢体再生的细胞内在分子需求。总之，我们的工作重申了CT细胞在墨西哥钝口螈肢体再生中的核心作用，并为识别肢体再生初始阶段控制芽基形成的分子机制奠定了基础。

extra.description: Axolotls (Ambystoma mexicanum) are known for their remarkable limb-regeneration abilities, which involve the formation of the blastema, a specialized structure consisting of progenitor cells contributed by all major tissues of the limb. Lateral plate mesoderm (LPM)-derived connective tissue (CT) cells dedifferentiate and play a critical role in blastema formation and subsequent limb regeneration. However, the complexity of the blastema cellular composition and the extent of CT participation and necessity have not been rigorously explored. To address this gap, we conducted spatial transcriptomics using a select array of probes, revealing that CT cells constitute up to 75% of the blastema cells. Genetic ablation of CT cells significantly delays or truncates limb regeneration, underscoring their necessity during this process. Analysis of the molecular profile during blastema formation identifies a temporally ordered gene expression pattern reflecting sequential phases of CT cell dedifferentiation, proliferation, and redifferentiation. Finally, a cell-cell communication inference identifies a CT-cell-autonomous FGFR1/AKT1 signaling axis as a cell-intrinsic molecular requirement for limb regeneration. Together, our work reaffirms the central role of CT cells in axolotl limb regeneration and lays the foundation for identifying molecular mechanisms that govern blastema formation during the initial phases of limb regeneration.

items.title: Predictive Multiplicity in Cell-Fate Assignment: Label-Free Rashomon Sets and the Limits of Per-Cell Certification
items.title_zh: 细胞命运分配中的预测多重性：无标签 Rashomon 集和逐细胞认证的局限
items.summary_zh: 单细胞轨迹推断将转录组测量映射到发育连续体上，但同样拟合数据的配置可能分配冲突的细胞命运。FateMultiplicity 是一个无标签框架，通过评估交叉拟合留出基因上的模型差异，在非劣效性测试下针对随机种子变异进行校准，构建统计可接受的模型集或 Rashomon 集，无需谱系标签。多重性很大，更多取决于模型空间的多样性而非其大小：第二个算法的十二种配置暴露 20.0% 的细胞，而第一个算法的二十四种配置暴露 3.8%。然后测试逐细胞认证命运边际 FM 是否比拟合模型已提供的产生更可靠的分配，结果并非如此。在模拟真实值上，在相同细胞上，FM 以 AUC 0.682 区分错误分配，而基线配置自身的决策边际为 0.965（p = 0.003），种子离散基线为 0.854。信息量由所接纳集的广度而非其基数决定：在基数四时，种子重拟合给出 0.933，超参数扰动集给出 0.701。将下确界放宽到

extra.description: Single-cell trajectory inference maps transcriptomic measurements onto developmental continua, yet configurations that fit the data equally well can assign conflicting cell fates. FateMultiplicity is a label-free framework that constructs a statistically admissible model set, or Rashomon set, without lineage labels, by evaluating model discrepancy on cross-fitted held-out genes under non-inferiority testing calibrated against random-seed variation. Multiplicity is large and depends more on the diversity of the model space than its size: twelve configurations of a second algorithm expose 20.0% of cells where twenty-four of the first expose 3.8%. Whether the per-cell certified fate margin FM yields more reliable assignments than the fitted model already provides is then tested, and it does not. On simulation ground truth, on the same cells, FM discriminates misassignment at AUC 0.682, against 0.965 for the baseline configuration's own decision margin (p = 0.003) and 0.854 for a seed-dispersion baseline. Informativeness is governed by the breadth of the admitted set, not its cardinality: at cardinality four, seed refits give 0.933 and hyperparameter-perturbed sets 0.701. Relaxing the infimum to a q-quantile recovers discrimination but converges toward the single model's own confidence; the supremum reaches 0.973 because theta*'s membership bounds it from below, while the infimum is unanchored. Multiplicity in trajectory inference is worth measuring and reporting, but per-cell certification over a label-free Rashomon set is not a route to more reliable fate calls. Two constructions survive: a margin-erosion ratio separates real from spurious branch points in simulation (AUC 0.890, untested on real data), and against clonally observed fate, uncertified cells disagree with their clone's outcome 16.4 percentage points more often than certified cells (p < 0.001).

items.title: Protocol for Discovering Convergent Molecular Networks across Multi-Omics Datasets Using Network Propagation
items.title_zh: 使用网络传播跨多组学数据集发现趋同分子网络的方案
items.summary_zh: 表型结果源于分子层之间的协调变化。尽管多组学数据捕捉互补的分子信号，但由于基因水平重叠有限，将其整合为连贯的生物机制仍然具有挑战性。网络传播将每个数据集中的重要基因命中映射到先验知识分子相互作用网络上，并将其信号扩散到邻近基因。对传播网络进行数学整合，随后进行聚类和通路富集，可揭示共享分子网络，从而指出跨正交分子层捕捉到的核心生物学。

extra.description: Phenotypic outcomes arise from coordinated changes across molecular layers. Although multi-omics data capture complementary molecular signals, integrating them into coherent biological mechanisms remains challenging due to limited overlap at the gene level. Network propagation maps significant gene hits from each dataset onto a prior knowledge molecular interaction network and diffuses their signals to neighboring genes. Mathematical integration of propagated networks, followed by clustering and pathway enrichment, reveals shared molecular networks, pinpointing the core biology captured across orthogonal molecular layers.

items.title: Orchestra: Corroboration-Based Regulatory Candidate Discovery via Composed Bioinformatics MCP Agents
items.title_zh: Orchestra：通过组合生物信息学MCP智能体进行基于佐证的调控候选发现
items.summary_zh: Orchestra将两个独立构建的生物信息学MCP服务器——RegNetAgents（从ARACNe网络推断基因调控网络拓扑）和CASCADE（提供四个独立证据源：LINCS敲低、DepMap必需性、超级增强子状态、DoRothEA转录因子置信度）——组合成一个通过模型上下文协议暴露的多智能体工作流。其核心架构主张是，要求RegNetAgents的拓扑证据和CASCADE的实验证据在候选调控因子上达成一致，比任一单独来源产生更可信的候选——此前未直接测试，因为RegNetAgents自身的验证仅询问其候选列表是否优于随机。我们在TCGA肿瘤获得性调控因子层级（基因肿瘤ARACNe网络中但不在GREmLN群体平均基线中的调控因子）上测试，通过ARACNe互信息（MI）边权重选择候选。在RegNetAgents已发表的BRCA/COAD焦点基因面板及匹配阴性对照上，CASCADE 4个来源中至

extra.description: Orchestra composes two independently built bioinformatics MCP servers -- RegNetAgents, which infers gene regulatory network topology from ARACNe networks, and CASCADE, which supplies four independent evidence sources (LINCS knockdown, DepMap essentiality, super-enhancer status, DoRothEA transcription-factor confidence) -- into one multi-agent workflow exposed via the Model Context Protocol. Its central architectural claim is that requiring RegNetAgents' topology evidence and CASCADE's experimental evidence to agree on a candidate regulator yields a more trustworthy candidate than either alone -- not previously tested directly, since RegNetAgents' own validation asked only whether its candidate lists beat chance. We test this on the TCGA tumor-acquired regulator tier (regulators in a gene's tumor ARACNe network but absent from the GREmLN population-averaged baseline), selecting candidates by ARACNe mutual-information (MI) edge weight. On RegNetAgents' published BRCA/COAD focal-gene panel plus matched negative controls, agreement among at least 2 of the 4 CASCADE sources predicts OncoKB cancer-gene status among focal genes (odds ratio 2.89, Benjamini-Hochberg-adjusted p=0.0166) but not among negative controls (p=0.0721); a single source is not diagnostic for either group. The pattern replicates and strengthens in a third cancer type, STAD, on a separately constructed panel (odds ratio 5.82), and against an independently curated ground truth (the Sanger COSMIC Cancer Gene Census). MI edge weight is the strongest single predictor overall (p=0.0003); a logistic-regression likelihood-ratio test confirms corroboration adds value beyond it in both panels (p=0.0234; p=0.0001). Every experiment invokes Orchestra's real agentic entry point.

items.title: LIBERO-PeRM: Benchmarking Personalized Robotic Manipulation
items.title_zh: LIBERO-PeRM：个性化机器人操作基准
items.summary_zh: 个性化对通用机器人进入家庭环境、实现真正实用至关重要。通用机器人操作已被广泛研究，但个性化机器人操作（PeRM）缺乏一个受控基准来区分任务完成与偏好满足。我们提出LIBERO-PeRM，一个具身智能体偏好学习基准。LIBERO-PeRM研究五个问题：1）策略在零样本设置下如何遵循偏好；2）如何从演示中学习单一偏好；3）随着演示增加，偏好获取效率如何；4）学到的偏好如何跨布局和任务泛化；5）策略如何组合偏好并在冲突下表现。我们提出仿真中可观测偏好的受控表述与分类体系，涵盖运动、技能和用户画像选择。该表述限于可用语言表达、可在LIBERO中实例化而不改变任务目标、可自动评估、可跨任务复用的偏好。基于LIBERO，我们的程序化流水线生成带偏好和不带偏好的配对演示。我们创建五个任务套件（312个任务），包含高质量演示、丰富元数据和偏好满足度指标。实验表明，当前VLA策略在零样本个性化上表现不佳，而

extra.description: Personalization is essential for general-purpose robots to transition into household environments and achieve true practicality. While general robotic manipulation has been extensively studied, personalized robotic manipulation (PeRM) lacks a controlled benchmark for separating task completion from preference satisfaction. We introduce LIBERO-PeRM, a benchmark for preference learning in embodied agents. LIBERO-PeRM studies five questions: 1) how policies follow preferences in zero-shot settings; 2) how they learn single preferences from demonstrations; 3) how efficiently they acquire preferences as demonstrations increase; 4) how learned preferences generalize across layouts and tasks; and 5) how policies compose preferences and behave under conflicts. We propose a controlled formulation and taxonomy of observable preferences in simulation, covering motion, skill, and user-profile choices. This formulation is restricted to language-expressible preferences that can be instantiated in LIBERO without changing the task goal, evaluated automatically, and reused across tasks. Building on LIBERO, our procedural pipeline generates paired demonstrations with and without preferences. We create five task suites (312 tasks) with high-quality demonstrations, rich metadata, and preference-satisfaction metrics. Experiments show that current VLA policies struggle with zero-shot personalization, while SFT makes preferences learnable. Mixed training achieves better no-preference retention than sequential adaptation and improves performance with contextual prompts compared with preference-only training, but can weaken motion-preference learning; preference generalization, decomposition, and conflict handling remain difficult. The code, datasets, and demos can be found on the project website: https://libero-perm.github.io/.

items.title: PathFM: Fast Generative Forecasting of Multivariate Trajectories
items.title_zh: PathFM：多变量轨迹的快速生成式预测
items.summary_zh: 时间序列基础模型在通用预测中日益流行。然而，大多数领先模型预测边际分位数，未指定未来轨迹的依赖结构。这一区别对轨迹相关量（如累积需求、峰值负荷和事件时序）很重要，但点和边际分数无法揭示。为建模这种依赖，我们提出PathFM，一种基于轨迹的预测模型，使用流匹配生成完整未来路径。我们进一步将模型蒸馏到一到两步，并在多次采样间共享历史注意力缓存。这些共同使PathFM能在约一次分位数模型查询的时间内为单条序列生成多条路径。蒸馏采样器还使直接优化校准损失变得实用。PathFM在既有预测基准fev-bench和TIME上取得有竞争力的边际精度。为补充这些评估，我们提出Forecast Path Score Bench（fps-bench），为fev-bench任务增加能量和变差函数分数及下游指标。PathFM在fps-bench上取得比所有评估的外部基线更高的聚合路径分数。混沌系统实验进一步表明，我

extra.description: Time series foundation models are becoming increasingly popular for general-purpose forecasting. However, most leading models predict marginal quantiles, leaving the dependence structure of future trajectories unspecified. This distinction matters for trajectory-dependent quantities such as cumulative demand, peak load, and event timing, yet point and marginal scores do not reveal it. To model this dependence, we introduce PathFM, a trajectory-based forecasting model that uses flow matching to generate complete future paths. We further distill the model to one or two steps and share history attention cache across draws. Together, these enable PathFM to generate multiple paths for a single series in roughly the time needed for one query to a quantile model. The distilled sampler also makes it practical to optimize a calibration loss directly. PathFM achieves competitive marginal accuracy on the established forecasting benchmarks fev-bench and TIME. To complement these evaluations, we introduce Forecast Path Score Bench (fps-bench), which augments fev-bench tasks with energy and variogram scores and downstream metrics. PathFM achieves a higher aggregate path score on fps-bench than all evaluated external baselines. Experiments on chaotic systems further show that our flow model sustains long-run variability, while strong baselines rapidly collapse. PathFM makes generative time series forecasting both competitive and practical, enabling diverse downstream applications.

items.title: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery
items.title_zh: FDE-Gym：AI交付的最后一公里
items.summary_zh: 现有智能体基准通常在由问题报告、规格说明或任务工单定义的明确任务上评估智能体。真实客户交付不同：前线部署工程师（FDE）必须澄清模糊需求、在实时系统中工作并发现未明说的约束。我们提出FDE-Gym，一个包含来自18个行业20个客户场景的95个端到端交付任务的基准，每个任务由行业专家从真实交付项目改编。在具有脚本化利益相关者和可修改客户系统的模拟客户环境中，智能体与利益相关者交互并在类生产系统上操作以交付可用解决方案。FDE-Gym根据交付对客户自身成功指标的改善程度评分，归一化在0（系统未变）到1（参考解决方案）之间，并对利益相关者交互（消息、试运行和等待时间）施加惩罚。在线平台让人类在相同评分标准下练习FDE技能。我们评估来自七个提供商的13种模型配置。在现实设置中，必须发现未明说约束，最佳配置取得平均FDE-Gym分数0.56，仅解决95个任务中的14个（分数至少0.8且无事故）。发现

extra.description: Existing agent benchmarks typically evaluate agents on well-specified tasks defined by issue reports, specifications, or task tickets. Real-world customer delivery is different: forward-deployed engineers (FDEs) must clarify ambiguous requirements, work in live systems, and uncover unstated constraints. We introduce FDE-Gym, a benchmark of 95 end-to-end delivery tasks from 20 customer scenarios across 18 sectors, each adapted by industry experts from real-world delivery projects. In simulated customer environments with scripted stakeholders and modifiable customer systems, agents interact with stakeholders and operate on production-like systems to deliver working solutions. FDE-Gym scores a delivery by how much it improves the customer's own success metric, normalized between 0 (unchanged system) and 1 (reference solution), with penalties for stakeholder interactions (messages, trial runs, and waiting time). An online platform lets humans practice FDE skills under the same grading criteria. We evaluate 13 model configurations from seven providers. In the realistic setting, where unstated constraints must be discovered, the best configuration achieves a mean FDE-Gym score of 0.56 and resolves only 14 of the 95 tasks (a score of at least 0.8 with no incident). Discovering unstated constraints is the primary bottleneck: performance drops sharply when models must uncover them without explicit guidance. Yet information discovery alone does not account for the gap: even on the 23 tasks where the best configuration obtains every key fact from stakeholders, it reaches a normalized business uplift of 0.8 or above on only 10. These results reveal a substantial gap between solving well-specified tasks and delivering effective AI systems for real customers.

items.title: GeoState: Learning View-Decoupled Geometry States for 3D World Modeling
items.title_zh: GeoState：学习用于3D世界建模的视角解耦几何状态
items.summary_zh: 近期3D世界模型越来越多地使用几何基础模型（GFM）的特征作为预测世界状态，受益于其丰富几何先验。然而这些特征的视角依赖性将场景动态与相机引起的变异纠缠在一起，使所得状态演化更难预测。我们提出GeoState，一种用于预测性3D世界建模的视角解耦几何表示，将场景状态演化与相机相关观测分离。具体而言，场景分词器将多视角GFM特征聚合为视角解耦场景状态，几何解码器使用相机射线查询。自回归世界模型随后预测未来场景状态，而相机运动单独建模。因此预测状态可在预测或外部指定相机下解码，同时在整个展开过程中保持单一上下文导出尺度，无需逐帧尺度对齐。实验表明，GeoState在Waymo上优于先前3D世界模型，支持几何一致的跨视角查询，并零样本泛化到KITTI和nuScenes。项目页面：https://hongchang-liu.github.io/GeoState-project-page/

extra.description: Recent 3D world models increasingly use features from geometry foundation models (GFMs) as predictive world states, benefiting from their rich geometric priors. However, the view dependence of these features entangles scene dynamics with camera-induced variation, making the resulting state evolution harder to predict. We propose GeoState, a view-decoupled geometry representation for predictive 3D world modeling that separates scene-state evolution from camera-dependent observation. Specifically, a scene tokenizer aggregates multi-view GFM features into a view-decoupled scene state, which a geometry decoder queries using camera rays. An autoregressive world model then predicts future scene states, while camera motion is modeled separately. The predicted states can therefore be decoded under either predicted or externally specified cameras, while retaining a single context-derived scale throughout the rollout without per-frame scale alignment. Experiments show that GeoState outperforms prior 3D world models on Waymo, supports geometrically consistent cross-view querying, and generalizes zero-shot to KITTI and nuScenes. Project page: https://hongchang-liu.github.io/GeoState-project-page/

items.title: Lean Graph Search for Formal Theorem Proving
items.title_zh: 用于形式化定理证明的Lean图搜索
items.summary_zh: 检索相关引理对形式化定理证明至关重要，使证明器能从已建立数学结果构建机器可验证证明。近期检索系统将库声明匹配到目标定理或其中间证明步骤，但对声明间多跳依赖利用有限。这些依赖可揭示不一定与目标定理词汇相似但在相关问题证明中反复出现的支持引理。为此，我们提出LeanGraphSearch，一种用于Lean 4的基于图的检索方法，从Mathlib的前向依赖构建图并遍历以通过多跳依赖链发现支持引理。具体而言，LeanGraphSearch将每个声明链接到其依赖的前提，使用基于图的排序算法将相关性从语义匹配声明传播到其依赖，并针对原始查询对扩展候选重新排序。在两个数学检索基准上，LeanGraphSearch在MathlibQR上比最强基线LeanSearch v2提升召回率最多12%，并在MathlibMPR上增加完整标注证明路径覆盖，额外覆盖最多3.7%的组。更重要的是，我们通过将LeanGra

extra.description: Retrieving relevant lemmas is crucial for formal theorem proving, enabling provers to build machine-checkable proofs from established mathematical results. Recent retrieval systems match library declarations to a target theorem or its intermediate proof steps, but make limited use of multi-hop dependencies among declarations. These dependencies can reveal supporting lemmas that are not necessarily lexically similar to the target theorem but recur in proofs of related problems. To this end, we propose LeanGraphSearch, a graph-based retrieval method for Lean 4 that constructs a graph from Mathlib's forward dependencies and traverses it to uncover supporting lemmas through multi-hop dependency chains. Specifically, LeanGraphSearch links each declaration to the premises it depends on, uses a graph-based ranking algorithm to propagate relevance from semantically matched declarations to their dependencies, and reranks the expanded candidates against the original query. Across two mathematical retrieval benchmarks, LeanGraphSearch improves recall by up to 12% over the strongest baseline, LeanSearch v2, on MathlibQR and increases coverage of complete annotated proof routes on MathlibMPR, covering up to 3.7% of extra groups. More importantly, we evaluate whether these retrieval gains translate into improved end-to-end theorem proving by integrating LeanGraphSearch into an iterative proving loop guided by Lean feedback. Across three theorem proving benchmarks, LeanGraphSearch improves pass rate at {8, 16, 32} reflection turns by as much as 40% compared to vanilla prover and at most 10% compared to LeanSearch v2, showing higher accuracy-cost efficiency. These findings highlight the value of dependency graph search for theorem proving and motivate further research on structure-aware search for proof discovery.

items.title: AVC-Reward: Event-Centric Audio-Video Consistency Evaluation
items.title_zh: AVC-Reward：以事件为中心的音频-视频一致性评估
items.summary_zh: 随着联合音频-视频生成模型能力增强，它们能生成展现三种复杂性的音频-视觉场景：多事件组合、多层音频混合和非对称跨模态关系。然而当前评估大多复用早期简单单向任务的指标。它们通常将音频-视频片段作为整体评估并依赖简单预定义关系，使其不适合这些日益复杂的场景。我们提出以事件为中心的评估框架，在事件层面解耦音频和视觉事件，独立分析每个事件，跨模态交叉验证关系，并将判断聚合为粗到细的三级一致性指标。该指标评估全局叙事和谐、事件级时间同步和细粒度属性对齐，为跨多样生成设置和跨模态关系的音频-视频一致性评估提供通用表述。我们将该指标实例化为AVC-Reward，一个可训练音频-视频奖励模型。为评估自动判断与人类感知在生成范式和关系复杂性上的一致性，我们构建AVC-Benchmark，主要来自各类音频-视频生成模型生成的多样正负样本。AVC-Reward在自动方法中实现与人类判断的最先进对齐，提供可解释理

extra.description: As joint audio-video generation models become more capable, they can generate audio-visual scenes exhibiting three forms of complexity: multi-event composition, multi-layer audio mixture, and asymmetric cross-modal relations. However, current evaluations largely reuse metrics from earlier simple and unidirectional tasks. They typically evaluate an audio-video clip as a whole and rely on simple predefined relations, making them unsuitable for these increasingly complex scenes. We propose an event-centric evaluation framework that disentangles audio and visual events at the event level, analyzes each event independently, cross-validates relations across modalities, and aggregates the judgments into a coarse-to-fine, three-level consistency metric. The metric assesses global narrative harmony, event-level temporal synchronization, and fine-grained attribute alignment, providing a general formulation for audio-video consistency evaluation across diverse generation settings and cross-modal relations. We instantiate the metric as AVC-Reward, a trainable audio-video reward model. To evaluate the agreement between automatic judgments and human perception across generation paradigms and relation complexities, we construct AVC-Benchmark, which is primarily built from diverse positive and negative samples generated by various types of audio-video generation models. AVC-Reward achieves state-of-the-art alignment with human judgment among automatic methods, provides interpretable rationales that localize failures, and improves the audio-video consistency of a joint generation model when used as an online reinforcement-learning signal. Project page: https://tsuki0512.github.io/AVC-Reward.github.io/

items.title: AI Consilium: a Benchmark of LLM Clinical Multidisciplinary Second Opinions
items.title_zh: AI Consilium：LLM临床多学科第二意见基准
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）可为复杂病例生成鉴别诊断，但有用的第二意见还必须事实有据、临床连贯、可操作且安全。我们开发了一个多维基准，使用300个诊断已解决的NEJM--MedQA病例：110个用于医生参考评分和Judge校准，190个用于留出评估。八种单模型流水线在自由形式和结构化临床推理条件下生成独立角色特定意见和交互式会诊报告。经医生校准的LLM Judge评估3,040份最终报告及相应结构化主角色输出。模型身份比响应格式更能区分报告质量。结构化最终报告在八种模型流水线中的七种具有更高总体平均分，其最明显优势在管理（2.740 vs. 2.436）。与结构化会诊前主角色意见相比，完整结构化综合在所有五个共享标准上汇总分数更高，其中问题优先级、事实依据和推理连贯性提升最大。GPT-5.6-Sol在每个评估组件中领先，并以最少审查轮次达成共识。这些发现表明，该基准能在同一常见病例评估中区分模型能

extra.description: Large language models (LLMs) can generate differential diagnoses for complex cases, but a useful second opinion must also be factually grounded, clinically coherent, actionable, and safe. We developed a multidimensional benchmark using 300 diagnostically resolved NEJM--MedQA cases: 110 for physician reference ratings and Judge calibration and 190 for held-out evaluation. Eight single-model pipelines generated independent role-specific opinions and interactive-consilium reports under free-form and structured clinical-reasoning conditions. A physician-calibrated LLM Judge evaluated 3,040 final reports and the corresponding structured primary-role outputs. Model identity separated report quality more strongly than response format. Structured final reports had higher overall mean scores in seven of eight model pipelines, with their clearest advantage in management (2.740 vs. 2.436). Compared with the structured pre-consilium primary-role opinion, the complete structured synthesis had higher pooled scores across all five shared criteria, with the largest increases in problem prioritization, factual grounding, and reasoning coherence. GPT-5.6-Sol led every evaluated component and reached consensus in the fewest review rounds. These findings show that the benchmark can distinguish model capability, the contribution of multidisciplinary synthesis, criterion-specific effects of response structure, deliberation dynamics, and inference requirements within one common-case evaluation.

items.title: CAT-alyzing Honesty: Continuous Adversarial Training for Transferable LLM Honesty
items.title_zh: CAT-alyzing Honesty：面向可迁移LLM诚实性的持续对抗训练
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在诚实至关重要的场景中日益普遍。然而尽管经过对齐训练，这些模型仍表现不诚实行为，如输出与某些知识矛盾或不受上下文支持的主张。我们提出持续对抗训练以实现一致诚实（CATCH），灵感来自最初为稳健拒绝有害查询开发的方法。CATCH训练模型趋向诚实答案并远离不诚实答案，同时保持模型能力。我们评估两种架构（Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct和Qwen3-3.6-27B）。我们表明，仅用数百个由自我报告场景构建的目标训练，CATCH学习到一种诚实行为，能稳健泛化并迁移到不同基准。它持续减少MASK上压力下的不诚实，增加Among Us多智能体游戏中的坦白，并提高AuditBench中模型隐藏行为的发现率。我们表明CATCH在提升诚实性上优于提示和监督微调，并与最先进诚实激活引导相当。然而得益于新颖的效用数据选择，CATCH在保持效用上超越诚实引导。

extra.description: Large language models (LLMs) are becoming prevalent in scenarios where honesty is critical. However, despite alignment training, these models still exhibit dishonest behaviour, such as outputting claims that contradict some knowledge or are not supported by what is accessible in context. We introduce Continuous Adversarial Training for Consistent Honesty (CATCH), inspired by a method originally developed to robustly refuse harmful queries. CATCH trains the model towards an honest answer and away from a dishonest one while maintaining the model's capabilities. We evaluate two architectures (Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and Qwen3-3.6-27B). We show that trained with only hundreds of targets built from self-reporting scenarios, CATCH learns an honest behaviour that robustly generalizes and transfers across distinct benchmarks. It consistently reduces dishonesty under pressure on MASK, increases confessions in the multi-agent game of Among Us, and improves the discovery rates of the model's hidden behaviours in AuditBench. We show that CATCH outperforms prompting and supervised fine-tuning in improving honesty, and it is on par with state-of-the-art honesty activation steering. However, CATCH surpasses honesty steering in maintaining utility, thanks to a novel choice of utility data.
